Body.Content:
Microsoft Edge is introducing an updated horizontal tab-strip appearance on Windows and macOS. The treatment uses rounded tabs with revised spacing and aligns related tab-strip controls with the refreshed browser-frame design. Tab behavior and enterprise data handling remain unchanged.

GA date: September CY2026
